The '''Sacred Pews''' were large benches that overlooked the [[Great Shell Dome]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fitsay]] where [[Sedrian]]s from every region of [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] would sit and watch the wonders of the [[Golden Sun]]. Pilgrims would sit in meditation waiting for the next opening of the Dome.<ref name="BGS" />
